name: User Profile
description: User prefers pytest for Python projects.
type: user
---

User prefers pytest for Python projects. Long-term decisions should be written to topic files with concise hooks in MEMORY.md.

---
name: Project Stack
description: CoPaw console frontend stack and evaluation routes.
type: project
---

The CoPaw console is a React and Vite frontend. The API server exposes evaluation routes under /evals.

---
name: Deployment
description: Docker Compose deployment and health check.
type: project
---

Deployment uses Docker Compose. The api service listens on port 8088 and health checks call /health.

---
name: Ollama Incident
description: ECONNREFUSED Ollama connection fix.
type: project
---

Fixed ECONNREFUSED by changing the Ollama base URL to http://127.0.0.1:11434.

---
name: Frontend Usage
description: Memory Evaluation upload workflow.
type: project
---

The Memory Evaluation page does not automatically read files from tests. Use Load Suite to upload a JSON suite, then click Run.

messages.content: Remember that the memory benchmark should report recall@k, MRR, nDCG, retention rate, and latency.
Recorded: memory benchmark reports recall@k, MRR, nDCG, retention rate, and latency.
The frontend workflow is: open Agent > Memory Eval, click Load Suite, select tests/memory_eval_frontend_suite.json, choose keyword backend, then click Run.
I will remember the Memory Eval workflow: open the page, load the JSON suite, choose keyword, and run it.
Update: the API route for memory evaluation is /evals/memory and it accepts backend plus suite in the request body.
Noted. Memory evaluation uses /evals/memory with backend and suite fields.

messages.content: The memory documents include profile, project stack, deployment, Ollama incident, and frontend usage notes. The most important regression is that uploaded suites must produce table rows in the frontend.
Key regression: uploaded suites should produce frontend table rows. Important docs: profile, project stack, deployment, Ollama incident, frontend usage.
